description: K₂NaVOF₅ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. There are four inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to two equivalent O and ten F atoms to form KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaOF₅ octahedra, and faces with four VOF₅ octahedra. Both K-O bond lengths are 3.02 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.05 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to two equivalent O and ten F atoms to form KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaOF₅ octahedra, and faces with four VOF₅ octahedra. Both K-O bond lengths are 3.02 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.06 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded to two equivalent O and ten F atoms to form KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaOF₅ octahedra, and faces with four VOF₅ octahedra. Both K-O bond lengths are 3.01 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.05 Å. In the fourth K site, K is bonded to two equivalent O and ten F atoms to form KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra, faces with four NaOF₅ octahedra, and faces with four VOF₅ octahedra. Both K-O bond lengths are 3.01 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six VOF₅ octahedra and faces with eight KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. The Na-O bond length is 2.37 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six VOF₅ octahedra and faces with eight KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. The Na-O bond length is 2.38 Å. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and four longer (2.28 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form VOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six NaOF₅ octahedra and faces with eight KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. The V-O bond length is 1.68 Å. There are four shorter (1.97 Å) and one longer (2.04 Å) V-F bond length. In the second V site, V is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form VOF₅ octahedra that share corners with six NaOF₅ octahedra and faces with eight KO₂F₁₀ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. The V-O bond length is 1.69 Å. There are four shorter (1.97 Å) and one longer (2.04 Å) V-F bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one V atom.
